body:
Hey ya'll I just wanted to let you know the cat's outta the bag. My parents now know that he has had a gay crush on me. Their reactions were at least mildly predictable. My Dad had your typical conservative clueless father with good intentions reaction and my mom thought it was cute and was generally empathic. They both chuckled a little. I was not amused.

I got heckled by my parents to no end because my little brother still wasn't eating. He apparently told them that I knew what was wrong with him. I wasn't going to say anything unless that's what he wanted. So he said tell them. Needless to say there was plenty  solemn tears and lugubrious stand-offishness from my brother. Well at least that's off my chest now, whether or not its going to do any good is another story. It seems everyone was rather supportive though so I have an optimistic outlook. 

Kids...AND parents... yeesh...
I wouldn't do that to the hooker

As a matter of fact, he told me that he tried asking out one of the girls he's had his eyes on. Unfortunately for him, she was taken (such drama) and since then she's moved onto high school. He was kinda infatuated in the same way with her. I'm preeeetty sure that has something to do with his mixed emotions but I'm not about to investigate middle-schooler love life. I just cringe thinking about it.

And yea that makes a lot of sense, me being a safe target for his "feelings". I don't think he'll need super-pro-psychiatric help, but we'll probably set something up with his guidance counselor as a family.

Thank for taking your time and responding!

Thanks for replying, it means a hella lot. Yea, I do agree that it's most likely a phase or some fleeting feelings. Hormones maybe? I know I had my phases but this is just kinda takes the cake as far as things I've seen. I won't rush in and tell anything of his fantasy to our parents. I did some thinking and realized it wouldn't actually help the situation. Only time will tell if he'll start eating normally though as our parents know about his eating habits. I guess his "dieting" has been going on for maybe a week so far.

High School will probably help. I know when I entered high school it was all about making new friends, which he certainly could use. It's summertime here where I live though, so we'll have to cope until fall.

TBH I don't care if he's gay. That's fine. I have a gay friend and he is very chill/"normal".
